definition: The power drawn by the servers, storage and network equipment themselves, excluding cooling and power-conversion losses. Facility power = IT load × PUE.
Funding a data center through a special-purpose vehicle or joint venture owned largely by outside investors, so most of the debt sits off the operator's balance sheet (e.g. Meta's Hyperion).
Average GPU-hours a large training job runs before a hardware or software fault interrupts it. Higher MTBI means less work lost to restarts.
The share of an investment that must be earned each year to repay it with interest over its life: r / (1 - (1 + r)^-n). Used to turn capex into an annual cost.
A powered, idle GPU or node kept ready to replace a failed one so a training job can continue. Spares raise reliability but lower utilization.
